title: Polish-Style Pork Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring pork and vibrant vegetables in a traditional Polish-inspired casserole.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions; set aside.
In a large skillet, cook sliced pork and polish sausage over medium-high heat until browned.
Add sliced bell pepper and onion to the skillet and cook until tender.
Stir in tomato paste, beef broth, and Dijon mustard (if using); bring to a simmer.
In a separate bowl, mix flour and a splash of beef broth to create a slurry.
Add the slurry to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet mixture to a casserole dish and top with cooked pasta.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the casserole is hot and the pasta is coated in the sauce.
Serve hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream (if desired).
Let the casserole rest for 10-15 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
